name: First Class Metals PLC
summary: First Class Metals PLC operates as a mineral exploration and development firm active across North America. The company's primary focus is on discovering and advancing gold deposits. Its premier asset is the North Hemlo property, which consists of 427 continuous single-cell mining claims. This substantial landholding, covering an area of roughly 89.6 square kilometers, is strategically positioned in northeastern Ontario, Canada, specifically to the northeast of Lake Superior. Incorporated in 2021, the company's head office is located in Blackburn, United Kingdom.
